cases.name: IMAGE & COLOUR exposes ordered professional grading sections
COPY ALL arms, spreads the condition to every other track, and undoes
switching the previewed condition disarms a pending COPY ALL
__apex.lightCopy('look') levels every track at that condition, and undoes
new grading controls clamp, persist, reset, and export

parts.semantics: Image grading section order; COPY ALL arm/fire/undo and condition-disarm; resolved-look copying; registry-derived clamp, persistence, export and shipped reset.
parts.fixturesAndLimits: Headless Bahrain; waits for LightPresets; synchronous DOM dispatch isolates arm timer. One real preview-chip click; storage reads and reload. No rendered grading oracle.

cases.name: the creator's WHEELS & BRAKES section offers a SIDEWALL INK colour row

parts.semantics: Creator exposes and edits SIDEWALL INK in WHEELS & BRAKES.
parts.fixturesAndLimits: Shared page; team 2 custom storage cleared; free-play entry; reveal containing tab. Geometry/colour-array contract delegated to unit twin.

cases.name: the creator's WHEELS & BRAKES section offers RIM and CALIPER colour rows

parts.semantics: Creator exposes RIM and CALIPER tint rows and activates edited rim tint.
parts.fixturesAndLimits: Shared page; same team/custom reset and reveal helper. Does not assert four-wheel mesh colours.

cases.name: is live before any game module evaluates
retains at the buffer threshold and prints at the console one
prefixes the namespace exactly once
flattens records instead of holding references
a track build reports through it, so the ring explains a build
logs() filters, and a bad spec is ignored rather than thrown

parts.semantics: Early availability, namespace threshold retention, console tagging, flattened records, track-build events, filters and invalid-level tolerance.
parts.fixturesAndLimits: sharedTest racePage/loadTrack/consoleLines; Log.clear in cases; cold toMenu before Monaco unless APEX_VM_PAGE. No performance/memory measurement.

cases.name: throttle accelerates from rest toward a high top speed
braking slows faster than coasting, both slower than throttle
driving onto the grass bleeds speed
steering is speed-sensitive: a tighter line at low speed than high
slope gravity: descents don't overspeed past top speed; climbs aren't a barrier
crossing the start/finish line advances s (wraps) and increments the lap

parts.semantics: Throttle acceleration, braking/coast ordering, grass drag, speed-sensitive steering, bounded slope response and lap wrap.
parts.fixturesAndLimits: Factory seat and pace 1; Monza/day/dry; Spa slope scan. Fixed steps; clearInput; lap case restores roadFollow 0. Bounds characterize model rather than exact top speed.

cases.name: mapPts and trackBounds hooks

parts.semantics: Normalized map points and world bounds with usable centerFrac orbit input.
parts.fixturesAndLimits: Headless default preload then Monaco; awaitTrackBuild; 300s. Coordinate-span proxy does not prove geographic north alignment or orbit pixels.

cases.name: baked tarmac does not crawl relative to procedural

parts.fixturesAndLimits: APEX_SHIMMER opt-in; 600s; Monza chase at 70m/s; frozen fixed steps; six frames each; 96×48 crop; restores matTex 1. GPU-sensitive ratio <2; diagnostic not hardware certification.
